label: Cement Truck Ingest
info:
MQTT (EMQX) -> validate -> MySQL.

Every topic passes through a `validate` node first. Output 1 = accepted (goes to the SQL builder). Output 2 = rejected (goes to the rejects table + debug).

Hostnames are Docker service names (emqx, mysql) from docker-compose.yml.

label: Test Publisher (no ESP32 yet)
info:
Publishes realistic fake cmt/{id} messages every 2s so the pipeline can run without hardware.
The orange inject publishes deliberately BAD messages so you can watch the guard reject them.
DISABLE this tab (right-click tab -> Disable) once a real ESP32 is publishing.
